accessibility.alt: Two lanes summarise support for the 2016 to 2019 post-pilot re-estimation. Of 64 historical episodes before support screening, 63 retain at least one comparable stratum and one is fully excluded. Of 6,581 exposed student-cohort observations, 391 are excluded and 6,190 remain. The support universe contains 82,753 control student-cohort observations; final samples differ by outcome.
accessibility.long_description: Two lanes summarise support for the 2016 to 2019 post-pilot re-estimation. Of 64 historical episodes before support screening, 63 retain at least one comparable stratum and one is fully excluded. Of 6,581 exposed student-cohort observations, 391 are excluded and 6,190 remain. The support universe contains 82,753 control student-cohort observations; final samples differ by outcome. Figure 1. Support flow for the post-pilot re-estimation. Aggregate counts precede outcome-specific eligibility, and the two units must not be added.
accessibility.non_color_encoding: Lanes, position, connectors, symbols, and numeric labels preserve meaning without colour.

decision.discard_condition: Discard if readers interpret episodes and observations as parts of the same total.
decision.rationale: It separates both units and shows support losses without implying a conserved total.
rejected_alternatives: Sankey: the units cannot be added and final samples vary by outcome.
Funnel: it would order heterogeneous counts as if they belonged to one conserved population.

evidence.denominator: 64 episodes and 6,581 exposed student-cohort observations before screening.
evidence.estimand: Descriptive counts before and after common-support screening.
evidence.population: Historical school-closure episodes and student-cohort observations, 2016–2019.
evidence.question: How much comparable support remains before each outcome-specific estimation?
evidence.transformation: Comparable-stratum screen; final eligibility varies by outcome.
evidence.uncertainty: Descriptive only: the counts are not an effect or equivalent independent cases.
evidence.unit: Closure episode and student-cohort observation; these units cannot be added.
